title: Partial Optimal Transport on the Circle for All Transported Masses in O(N log N)
abstract: arXiv:2608.23910v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Partial optimal transport compares two measures while leaving part of the mass unmatched, which is what makes it robust to outliers, occlusion, and clutter. The quantity of interest is usually the whole profile - the optimal cost at every transported cardinality - because the right amount to transport is rarely known in advance, and on the real line the PAWL algorithm returns that profile in $O(N\log N)$. Much data is periodic rather than linear: angles, phases, orientations, time of day, hue, and every direction obtained by projecting onto a great circle. On the circle the same problem acquires a global circulation, or equivalently an optimized cut, which the naive exact method handles by running the line algorithm once per support gap, at $O(N^{2}\log N)$. We show that this factor $N$ is unnecessary. The line structure survives in cut-free form, and a free-gap invariant supplies, at every step, a cut at which all previous local updates

translated_title: 圆周上所有传输质量的偏最优传输在O(N log N)复杂度下的实现
translated_abstract: 偏最优传输比较两个测度时，允许部分质量不匹配，这使其对异常值、遮挡和杂波具有鲁棒性。通常关注的量是整个轮廓——即每个传输基数下的最优成本——因为正确的传输量很少事先已知，而在实直线上，PAWL算法以O(N log N)的复杂度返回该轮廓。许多数据是周期性的而非线性的：角度、相位、方向、时间、一天中的时刻、色调，以及通过投影到大圆上获得的每个方向。在圆上，相同的问题引入了全局循环，或等价地一个优化的切割，而朴素精确方法通过在每个支撑间隙上运行一次直线算法来处理，复杂度为O(N^2 log N)。我们表明，这个因子N是不必要的。直线结构以无切割形式幸存，并且一个自由间隙不变量在每一步提供当前所有局部更新适用的切割。
tldr: 本文提出一种在圆周上计算偏最优传输轮廓的新方法，通过无切割结构和自由间隙不变量，将复杂度从O(N^2 log N)降至O(N log N)，适用于所有传输质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel method for computing the partial optimal transport profile on the circle, reducing complexity from O(N^2 log N) to O(N log N) via a cut-free structure and free-gap invariant, applicable to all transported masses.
